caption:
Repentance: Allah is delighted when you turn back to Him.

The Prophet ﷺ said that Allah is more delighted with the repentance of one of us than a person is on finding his lost animal. As the day ends, turn back to Him with whatever today held.

Jami at-Tirmidhi 3538 · Grade: Sahih

Before you sleep tonight, say astaghfirullah and mean it.

#tawbah #repentance #astaghfirullah #nightreminder
alt_text: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:“Allah is more delighted with the repentance of one of you, than one of you is, when finding his lost animal.” (Jami at-Tirmidhi 3538)
